versos.texto_bv: Na virada do ano, o rei Nabucodonosor mandou buscá-lo e o levou para a Babilônia, junto com os utensílios preciosos da casa do SENHOR. Então fez Zedequias, irmão de Joaquim, rei sobre Judá e Jerusalém.
versos.traducao_literal: E, no retorno do ano, enviou o rei Nabucodonosor, e o fez vir à Babilônia com os utensílios desejáveis da casa do SENHOR; e fez reinar Zedequias, irmão dele, sobre Judá e Jerusalém.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): 'Na virada do ano' pode ser lido por um falante de PT-BR contemporâneo como referência ao Réveillon (31/12-1/1), sentido não pretendido pelo idiotismo hebraico de marcação temporal (época de campanhas militares/mudança do ano regnal); NTLH, ARA e NVIPT convergem em 'primavera'. — evidência: traducao_literal: 'no retorno do ano'; NTLH: 'Na primavera daquele ano'; ARA: 'Na primavera seguinte'; NVIPT: 'Na primavera'.

kjv.texto: And when the year was expired, king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of the house of the Lord, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

vizinhos.9: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign, and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of the Lord.
vizinhos.11: Zedekiah was one and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned eleven years in Jerusalem.

web.texto: At the return of the year king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Babylon, with the goodly vessels of Yahweh’s house, and made Zedekiah his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem.

vizinhos.9: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months and ten days in Jerusalem: and he did that which was evil in the sight of Yahweh.
vizinhos.11: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem:
